chunks: Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ja'far Al-Howl, from Sallam ibn Al-Mustaneer, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, created Paradise before He created the Fire, and created obedience before He created disobedience, and created Mercy before Anger, and created Good before Evil, and created the Earth before the Sky, and created Life before Death, and created the Sun before the Moon, and created Light before Darkness.
ai.seo_question: What is the order of creation according to Shia hadith regarding Paradise, Fire, and divine attributes?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) articulates the principle of 'Asl' (primacy) and 'Far' (derivation), establishing that goodness, mercy, and light are the fundamental realities of creation, while their counterparts are secondary. This aligns with the Shia theological concept of 'Tawhid al-Af'al' where God's primary attribute is benevolence, reinforcing the idea that existence itself is inherently positive. The sequence mirrors the cosmic hierarchy, suggesting that spiritual and physical realities follow a similar pattern of origin and development.

en.hubeali: H 14564 – Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ja’far Al-Howl, from Sallaam Bin Al-Mustaneer, who has narrated the following: Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘

Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Created the Paradise before He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the Fire, and Created the obedience before He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the disobedience, and Created the Mercy before the Anger, and Created the good before the evil, and Created the earth before the sky, and Created the life before the death, and Created the sun before the moon, and Created the ‘النُّورَ’ (the Divine Light) before the darkness’.
en.sarwar: 116. Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ja’far Al-Howl, from Sallaam Bin Al-Mustaneer, who has narrated the following: Abu Ja’far (a.s.) said:

‘Allah (azwj) Created the Paradise before He (azwj) Created the Fire, and Created the obedience before He (azwj) Created the disobedience, and Created the Mercy before the Anger, and Created the good before the evil, and Created the earth before the sky, and Created the life before the death, and Created the sun before the moon, and Created the ‘النُّورَ’ (the Divine Light) before the darkness’.
